program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 8.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Itail": (240e-6, 100e-6, 400e-6),
    "Ic":    (120e-6, 40e-6, 250e-6),
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "Lpc":   (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Ln":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "vsdp":  (0.30, 0.20, 0.45),
    "vdsn":  (0.25, 0.18, 0.40),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    I1 = p["Itail"] / 2.0
    Ic = p["Ic"]
    Ips = I1 + Ic
    Ib = 20e-6
    vfold = vdd - p["vsdp"]

    # Input pair: iterate on the source voltage to include body effect
    vs = 0.2
    for _ in range(4):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=max(vfold - vs, 0.2), vsb=vs)
        vs = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.05)

    # Tail and reference (NMOS, L = 1 um for mirror accuracy)
    gmid_t, Lt = 14.0, 1.0
    mt = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, p["Itail"], vds=vs)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=0.65)
    mref = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, iref, vds=mref.vgs)
    msk = lut.size("n", gmid_t, Lt, Ib, vds=0.8)

    # PMOS folding current sources and the vbp diode
    gmid_p = 8.0
    mps = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ips, vds=p["vsdp"])
    mbp = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ib, vds=1.0)
    mbp = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ib, vds=mbp.vgs)
    mbr = lut.size("p", gmid_p, p["Lp"], Ib, vds=0.5)

    # PMOS cascodes (bulk tied to own source, so no body effect)
    vout0 = vcm
    mpc = lut.size("p", 12.0, p["Lpc"], Ic, vds=max(vfold - vout0, 0.2))
    vbpc = max(vfold - mpc.vgs, 0.05)
    Rbpc = vbpc / Ib

    # NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror
    mnb = lut.size("n", 10.0, p["Ln"], Ic, vds=p["vdsn"])
    mnc = lut.size("n", 12.0, p["Ln"], Ic, vds=max(vout0 - p["vdsn"], 0.2), vsb=p["vdsn"])
    vbnc = p["vdsn"] + mnc.vgs
    Rbnc = (vdd - vbnc) / Ib

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # Reference and bias network
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("MSK1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", msk)
    n.dev("MBP", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbp)
    n.dev("MBR", "vbpc", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mbr)
    n.R("RBPC", "vbpc", "vss", Rbpc)
    n.dev("MSK2", "vbnc", "ibias", "vss", "vss", msk)
    n.R("RBNC", "vdd", "vbnc", Rbnc)
    # Input pair: vinp drives the left fold node (left feeds the mirror diode side), so it is non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "fl", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fr", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    # PMOS folding sources
    n.dev("MP1", "fl", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    n.dev("MP2", "fr", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
    # PMOS cascodes
    n.dev("MPC1", "nl", "vbpc", "fl", "fl", mpc)
    n.dev("MPC2", "vout", "vbpc", "fr", "fr", mpc)
    # NMOS cascode mirror (low-voltage)
    n.dev("MNC1", "nl", "vbnc", "na", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("MNC2", "vout", "vbnc", "nb", "vss", mnc)
    n.dev("MNB1", "na", "nl", "vss", "vss", mnb)
    n.dev("MNB2", "nb", "nl", "vss", "vss", mnb)

    # Predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    rup = (mpc.gm / mpc.gds) * (1.0 / (mps.gds + m1.gds))
    rdn = (mnc.gm + mnc.gmbs) / mnc.gds * (1.0 / mnb.gds)
    rout = rup * rdn / (rup + rdn)
    gain = gm1 * rout
    cout = cl + mpc.cdd + mnc.cdd
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cfold = mps.cdd + m1.cdd + mpc.cgg
    pfold = mpc.gm / (2 * PI * cfold)
    pmir = mnb.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * mnb.cgg + mnc.cdd + mpc.cdd))
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pfold)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    itot = 2 * Ips + iref + 3 * Ib
    return n, {"gain_db": db(gain), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": vdd * itot,
               "slew": p["Itail"] / cout}

events.topology: Folded cascode (NMOS input, PMOS folding sources and cascodes, NMOS low-voltage cascode mirror)
